title: Developer
description: Install builds on a simulator or phone; convert SVG, JSON and CSV for code; copy files for an LLM, diff, permalinks and checksums. Drop a folder for clone, clean, fresh install, pull, repo page, zip, sizes and lines of code.

actions.label: iOS Sim
actions.description: Install on the booted iOS Simulator and launch it
actions.command: xcrun simctl install booted "$INPUT" && b=$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :CFBundleIdentifier' "$INPUT/Info.plist") && xcrun simctl launch booted "$b" >/dev/null

actions.label: Android
actions.description: Install on the connected device or emulator
actions.command: export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools"; adb install -r "$INPUT"

actions.label: TSX
actions.description: SVG to a React TSX component (needs network on first run)
actions.command: t=$(mktemp -d) && npx -y @svgr/cli@8.1.0 --typescript --icon --jsx-runtime automatic --out-dir "$t" "$INPUT" && for f in "$t"/*.tsx; do mv "$f" "$(fw_out "$DIR/${f:t}")"; done

actions.label: TS types
actions.description: TypeScript types from JSON (needs network on first run)
actions.command: npx -y quicktype@23.2.6 "$INPUT" --lang ts --just-types --top-level "$NAME" -o "$(fw_out "$DIR/$NAME.types.ts")"

actions.label: JSON
actions.description: Convert CSV to JSON
actions.command: python3 -c 'import csv,json,os,sys;r=list(csv.DictReader(open(os.environ["INPUT"],encoding="utf-8")));json.dump(r,open(sys.argv[1],"w",encoding="utf-8"),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)' "$(fw_out "$DIR/$NAME.json")"

actions.label: App icon
actions.description: Make a macOS .icns icon set from a PNG
actions.command: d=$(mktemp -d)/$NAME.iconset; mkdir -p "$d"; for s in 16 32 128 256 512; do sips -z $s $s "$INPUT" --out "$d/icon_${s}x${s}.png" >/dev/null; sips -z $((s*2)) $((s*2)) "$INPUT" --out "$d/icon_${s}x${s}@2x.png" >/dev/null; done; iconutil -c icns "$d" -o "$(fw_out "$DIR/$NAME.icns")"

actions.label: For LLM
actions.description: Copy the file, or a folder tree, as a fenced block with its path for a chat
actions.command:
if [ -d "$INPUT" ]; then { printf '%s
' "Folder: $INPUT" '```'; (cd "$INPUT" && find . -maxdepth 3 -not -path '*/.git/*' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -name .DS_Store -not -name . | sort); printf '%s
' '```'; } | pbcopy; else [[ $(file -b --mime-encoding "$INPUT") != binary ]] || { echo 'Binary file: nothing to paste' >&2; exit 1; }; { printf '%s
' "File: $INPUT" "\`\`\`${INPUT:e}"; head -c 200000 "$INPUT"; printf '
%s
' '```'; } | pbcopy; fi

actions.label: Format
actions.description: Pretty-print JSON (2 spaces) into name.pretty.json
actions.command: python3 -m json.tool --indent 2 "$INPUT" > "$(fw_out "$DIR/$NAME.pretty.json")"

actions.label: Minify
actions.description: Strip whitespace from JSON into name.min.json
actions.command: python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.dumps(json.load(open(sys.argv[1])),separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False))' "$INPUT" > "$(fw_out "$DIR/$NAME.min.json")"

actions.label: Permalink
actions.description: Copy a GitHub link to this file at the current commit (push it first)
actions.command: d="${INPUT:A}"; [ -d "$d" ] || d="${d:h}"; root=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || { echo 'Not inside a git repository' >&2; exit 1; }; sha=$(git -C "$root" rev-parse HEAD); url=$(git -C "$root" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's#^git@([^:]+):#https://\1/#; s#^ssh://git@([^/]+)/#https://\1/#; s#\.git$##'); [[ -n $url ]] || { echo 'No origin remote' >&2; exit 1; }; p="${INPUT:A}"; rel="${p#$root}"; rel="${rel#/}"; if [ -d "$p" ]; then kind=tree; else kind=blob; fi; printf '%s/%s/%s/%s' "$url" "$kind" "$sha" "$rel" | pbcopy

actions.label: Diff files
actions.description: Compare two files in VS Code (or FileMerge); images use Image diff
actions.command: files=("${(@f)INPUTS}"); c="/Applications/Visual Studio Code.app/Contents/Resources/app/bin/code"; if [[ -x $c ]]; then "$c" --diff "${files[1]}" "${files[2]}"; elif command -v opendiff >/dev/null; then opendiff "${files[1]}" "${files[2]}"; else echo 'Install VS Code or Xcode to diff files' >&2; exit 1; fi

actions.label: Verify
actions.description: Check the file against a SHA-256 you copied
actions.command: a=$(shasum -a 256 "$INPUT" | cut -d' ' -f1); b=$(pbpaste | tr -d '[:space:]' | tr 'A-F' 'a-f'); [[ ${#b} -eq 64 ]] || { echo 'Copy a SHA-256 (64 hex characters) first' >&2; exit 1; }; [[ $a == $b ]] || { echo "SHA-256 does NOT match. File: $a Clipboard: $b" >&2; exit 1; }

actions.label: Clone
actions.description: Clone a git repo into this folder (paste an https or ssh URL, watch the progress)
actions.command: open "flickwheel://clone?path=$(perl -e 'print join q(), map { /[A-Za-z0-9_.~-]/ ? $_ : sprintf(q(%%%02X), ord) } split //, shift' "$INPUT")"

actions.label: Clean
actions.description: Delete node_modules, .next, __pycache__, Pods, target and other rebuildable folders (asks first)
actions.command:
cd "$INPUT" || exit 1
names=(node_modules .next .nuxt .turbo .parcel-cache .svelte-kit __pycache__ .pytest_cache .mypy_cache .ruff_cache .gradle DerivedData Pods target .build)
expr=(); for n in $names; do expr+=(-o -name "$n"); done
found=("${(@f)$(find . -name .git -prune -o -type d \( -name .fw-none $expr \) -prune -print 2>/dev/null)}")
list=(); for p in $found; do [[ -n $p ]] || continue; case ${p:t} in Pods) [[ -f ${p:h}/Podfile ]] || continue;; target) [[ -f ${p:h}/Cargo.toml || -f ${p:h}/pom.xml ]] || continue;; .build) [[ -f ${p:h}/Package.swift ]] || continue;; esac; list+=("$p"); done
[[ ${#list} -gt 0 ]] || { echo 'Nothing to clean here' >&2; exit 1; }
kb=$(du -sk "${list[@]}" | awk '{s+=$1} END{print s}')
msg="Delete ${#list} folder(s), about $((kb/1024)) MB, inside ${INPUT:t}?"$'\n'; for p in ${list[1,10]}; do msg+=$'\n'"${p#./}"; done; (( ${#list} > 10 )) && msg+=$'\n'"...and $((${#list}-10)) more"
MSG=$msg osascript -e 'display dialog (system attribute "MSG") buttons {"Cancel","Delete"} default button "Cancel" cancel button "Cancel" with icon caution with title "FlickWheel"' >/dev/null || { echo Cancelled >&2; exit 1; }
for p in "${list[@]}"; do rm -rf -- "$p"; done

actions.label: Pull
actions.description: git pull --ff-only in this repo
actions.command: GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -o BatchMode=yes' git -C "$INPUT" pull --ff-only --quiet

actions.label: Repo
actions.description: Open the repo's origin on the web
actions.command: u=$(git -C "$INPUT" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's#^git@([^:]+):#https://\1/#; s#^ssh://git@([^/]+)/#https://\1/#; s#\.git$##'); [[ $u == http*://* ]] || { echo 'No web origin remote' >&2; exit 1; }; open "$u"

actions.label: Zip src
actions.description: Zip the folder without .git, node_modules and build caches
actions.command: cd "$DIR" && zip -qr "$(fw_out "$DIR/${INPUT:t}-src.zip")" "${INPUT:t}" -x '*/.git/*' '*/node_modules/*' '*/.next/*' '*/Pods/*' '*/DerivedData/*' '*/.build/*' '*/__pycache__/*' '*/.DS_Store'

actions.label: Sizes
actions.description: Copy the biggest items in the folder with their sizes
actions.command: { printf 'Total %s\n' "$(du -sh "$INPUT" | cut -f1)"; (cd "$INPUT" && du -sh -- *(DN) | sort -rh | head -25); } | pbcopy

actions.label: Fresh install
actions.description: Delete node_modules or Pods and reinstall from the lockfile (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, CocoaPods, Bundler; asks first)

actions.label: Lines
actions.description: Count lines of code per language in a window, with a Copy button (respects .gitignore in a git repo)
actions.command: open "flickwheel://lines?path=$(perl -e 'print join q(), map { /[A-Za-z0-9_.~-]/ ? $_ : sprintf(q(%%%02X), ord) } split //, shift' "$INPUT")"
